name: Thirdweb legacy Bridge approval incident
summary: Thirdweb reports unauthorized token movement affecting one Ethereum wallet through a legacy Bridge that remained active after an earlier mitigation. This proposal uses the December 10 notification date only as a research anchor; the exact attack date and loss are not established.

primary_sources.summary: Protocol incident report identifies the legacy Bridge address, reports one affected Ethereum wallet, and describes decommissioning omissions.

coverage_gaps: December 10 is the report-received date, not a proven attack timestamp; incident_date intentionally remains null.
The address is the vulnerable legacy integration contract, not the affected user wallet; victim-wallet and exploit transaction identifiers remain unresolved.
The report contains December 10 versus December 11 upgrade-timing statements that need reconciliation using chain evidence.
Chain, language, identifiers, historical implementation and economic impact are source-reported, not independently verified by Hindsight.
Source rights, earliest disclosure, exploit-family boundaries and human adjudication remain unresolved. No training or benchmark eligibility is established.
